name: read-into-memory
description: The read_into memory helper memory.mjs and its Jet twin Memory.jet (#5976 c112): build both arms of the net_read_into_vs_read pair, plain and with the counting allocator, read each counted build's allocation facts through gdb at exit_group, sample peak RSS of the plain builds through the gauntlet timer, and print the per-metric verdicts. The fixtures are stand-ins: a `jet` whose build writes a program printing the pair's expected output and its read count, and a `gdb` that runs it and prints fixed counting facts per arm. The check prints every summary fact but the host and the command line; peak RSS is the timer's real reading, so for it the check shows that it was measured and judged.
